text: Every DEF subtraction in both builds is immediately floored by the ATTACKER's minimum damage, so defence can never reduce a hit below that floor — a term the 'DEF is flat subtraction' statement omits. A Sim that subtracts DEF without the floor will produce zero-damage hits the original never produces.
